entities.name: AS Security
entities.description: Access Stratum security comprising integrity protection and ciphering for RRC signalling (SRBs) and user data (DRBs). Handles configuration of security parameters including algorithms and keys.

entities.name: RRC Integrity Protection
entities.description: Integrity protection mechanism for RRC signalling messages using security keys and algorithms.

entities.name: RRC Ciphering
entities.description: Ciphering/encryption mechanism for RRC signalling messages using security keys and algorithms.

entities.name: DRB Integrity Protection
entities.description: Integrity protection mechanism for user data over DRBs, with enable/disable settings per PDU session.

entities.name: DRB Ciphering
entities.description: Ciphering/encryption mechanism for user data over DRBs, with enable/disable settings per PDU session.

entities.name: K_RRCint
entities.description: Security key used for integrity protection of RRC signalling.

entities.name: K_RRCenc
entities.description: Security key used for ciphering of RRC signalling.

entities.name: K_UPint
entities.description: Security key used for integrity protection of user data.

entities.name: K_UPenc
entities.description: Security key used for ciphering of user data.

entities.name: K_gNB
entities.description: Master security key from which all AS security keys are derived, based on K_AMF from upper layers.

entities.name: COUNT
entities.description: Independent counter maintained for each radio bearer and direction, used as input for ciphering and integrity protection.

entities.name: NULL Algorithm Usage Condition
entities.description: Conditions under which NULL integrity protection (nia0) and NULL ciphering (nea0) algorithms are used, including limited service mode UE and SRB usage.

entities.name: Security Key Update
entities.description: Procedure to refresh secondary keys and avoid COUNT reuse, triggered by reconfiguration with sync, connection re-establishment, or connection resume.

relations.description: AS security includes RRC integrity protection as a fundamental component.
AS security includes RRC ciphering as a fundamental component.
AS security includes DRB integrity protection for user data.
AS security includes DRB ciphering for user data.
K_gNB master key is used to derive K_RRCint for RRC integrity protection.
K_gNB master key is used to derive K_RRCenc for RRC ciphering.
K_gNB master key is used to derive K_UPint for user data integrity protection.
K_gNB master key is used to derive K_UPenc for user data ciphering.
COUNT value is used as input for RRC integrity protection algorithms.
COUNT value is used as input for RRC ciphering algorithms.
NULL integrity protection algorithm (nia0) is used under specific conditions including limited service mode.
NULL ciphering algorithm (nea0) is used when NULL integrity protection is used.
Security key update procedure changes AS security keys including K_gNB upon reconfiguration with sync, connection re-establishment, or connection resume.
RRC integrity protection and ciphering are always activated together in one message/procedure.
